steps.name: environment - install OpenJDK, Android cmdline-tools and minimal build-tools (idempotent, logged, retry-capable)
steps.description: Install OpenJDK 11+, download Android command-line tools into /opt/android-sdk using atomic temp-dir moves, install platform-tools and a minimal build-tools revision (build-tools;33.0.2). Accept SDK licenses non-interactively, persist ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/ANDROID_HOME and JAVA_HOME and prepend SDK bins to PATH via /etc/profile.d/android.sh (without embedding the current PATH literal). Validate java version >=11, sdkmanager and adb availability, capture tool outputs to workspace logs, and add simple retry/backoff for sdkmanager network installs. Use a lockfile to avoid concurrent runs.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
LOCKFILE="/var/lock/notes_native_app_setup.lock"
if ! sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOCKFILE")"; then echo 'cannot create lock dir' >&2; exit 10; fi
exec 9>"$LOCKFILE" || exit 11
if ! flock -n 9; then echo 'another setup run in progress' >&2; exit 12; fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs"
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends openjdk-11-jdk unzip wget ca-certificates gnupg -q >/dev/null
# verify java >=11
JAVA_BIN=$(command -v java || true)
if [ -z "$JAVA_BIN" ]; then echo 'java not found after install' >&2; exit 20; fi
JAVA_VER=$($JAVA_BIN -version 2>&1 | awk -F '"' '/version/ {print $2}' | cut -d'.' -f1)
if [ -z "$JAVA_VER" ]; then JAVA_VER=$($JAVA_BIN -version 2>&1 | sed -n '1p'); fi
# crude numeric check: accept 11 or higher major
if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JAVA_MAJOR=$(java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' '/version/ {v=$2; if(v ~ /1\./){print substr(v,3,2)} else {split(v,a,"."); print a[1]}}')
  if [ -z "$JAVA_MAJOR" ] || [ "$JAVA_MAJOR" -lt 11 ]; then echo 'OpenJDK 11+ required' >&2; exit 21; fi
fi
ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
CT_ZIP="$TMPDIR/cmdline.zip"
CT_URL="https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-latest.zip"
sudo mkdir -p "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
sudo chown root:root "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" || true
# download and extract to temp then move atomically
wget -q --timeout=30 --tries=3 "$CT_URL" -O "$CT_ZIP"
unzip -q "$CT_ZIP" -d "$TMPDIR/cmdline" || (rm -rf "$TMPDIR" && echo 'failed to unzip cmdline' >&2 && exit 22)
# normalize layout: cmdline-tools may be top-level or packaged under cmdline-tools
if [ -d "$TMPDIR/cmdline/cmdline-tools" ]; then
  sudo rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools" || true
  sudo mkdir -p "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools"
  sudo mv "$TMPDIR/cmdline/cmdline-tools" "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
else
  sudo rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools" || true
  sudo mkdir -p "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
  sudo mv "$TMPDIR/cmdline"/* "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/" || true
fi
sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
sudo chmod -R a+rx "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" || true
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
# persist env safely by prepending paths (do not capture current PATH literal)
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/android.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
export ANDROID_HOME="/opt/android-sdk"
export PATH="/opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools:${PATH}"
# set JAVA_HOME dynamically if java present
if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export JAVA_HOME="$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)" | sed 's:/bin/java::')"
fi
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/android.sh
# source for current session
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
source /etc/profile.d/android.sh
SDKMANAGER="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then chmod +x "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/cmdline-tools/latest/bin"/* || true; fi
if [ -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then :; elif command -v sdkmanager >/dev/null 2>&1; then SDKMANAGER=$(command -v sdkmanager); else echo 'sdkmanager missing; check cmdline-tools extraction' >&2; ls -la "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/android_sdk_ls.txt" 2>&1; exit 23; fi
# accept licenses and install packages with retries and logging
retry() { local n=0; local max=3; local backoff=3; until [ $n -ge $max ]; do "$@" && return 0; n=$((n+1)); sleep $((backoff * n)); done; return 1; }
# list available - capture once
"$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" --list > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/sdkmanager_list.txt" 2>&1 || true
# install platform-tools
if ! grep -q "platform-tools" "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/sdkmanager_list.txt"; then
  retry yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" --install "platform-tools" > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/sdkmanager_install_platform-tools.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'failed install platform-tools' >&2; exit 24; }
fi
# install build-tools 33.0.2 if missing
BUILD_VER="build-tools;33.0.2"
if ! grep -q "$BUILD_VER" "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/sdkmanager_list.txt"; then
  retry yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" --install "$BUILD_VER" > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/sdkmanager_install_build-tools-33.0.2.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'failed install build-tools' >&2; exit 25; }
fi
# log versions
java -version 2>&1 | head -n1 > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/java_version.txt" || true
"$SDKMANAGER" --version 2>&1 | head -n1 > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/sdkmanager_version.txt" || true
if [ -x "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/platform-tools/adb" ]; then "${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/platform-tools/adb" version > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/adb_version.txt" 2>&1 || true; fi
# release lock
flock -u 9 || true

steps.name: scaffolding - detect project type, install Flutter SDK (stable) if pubspec.yaml present, create helper scripts
steps.description: Detect whether workspace contains Flutter (pubspec.yaml) or React Native (package.json). If Flutter is present, install Flutter stable into /opt/flutter via atomic git clone into temp and move, set FLUTTER_ROOT/FLUTTER_HOME and prepend /opt/flutter/bin to PATH via /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh, capture flutter --version to logs and avoid running interactive doctor steps. For React Native, detect react-native in dependencies or devDependencies robustly and generate start/build helper scripts that use the absolute workspace path and npx/yarn where appropriate.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs"
LOCKFILE="/var/lock/notes_native_app_setup.lock"
exec 9>"$LOCKFILE" || exit 11
flock 9 || true
# Flutter path check
if [ -f "pubspec.yaml" ]; then
  if [ ! -d "/opt/flutter" ]; then
    TMP=$(mktemp -d)
    git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$TMP/flutter" > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/flutter_clone.txt" 2>&1 || (rm -rf "$TMP" && echo 'flutter clone failed' >&2 && exit 30)
    sudo rm -rf /opt/flutter || true
    sudo mv "$TMP/flutter" /opt/flutter
    sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /opt/flutter
    sudo chmod -R a+rx /opt/flutter/bin || true
    rm -rf "$TMP"
  fi
  sudo tee /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
export FLUTTER_ROOT="/opt/flutter"
export FLUTTER_HOME="/opt/flutter"
export PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:${PATH}"
EOF
  sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh || true
  /opt/flutter/bin/flutter --version > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/flutter_version.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'flutter missing or failed --version' >&2; exit 31; }
  # create start helper
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
/opt/flutter/bin/flutter run --no-sound-null-safety || true
SH
  chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/start.sh"
else
  # React Native detection: check dependencies and devDependencies safely
  if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    if node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({}, p.dependencies||{}, p.devDependencies||{}); process.exit(deps['react-native']?0:1)" 2>/dev/null; then
      # prefer yarn if yarn.lock exists
      if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        START_CMD='yarn start'
      else
        START_CMD='npm run start --silent'
      fi
      cat > "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" <<SH
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
$START_CMD || npx react-native start
SH
      cat > "$WORKSPACE/build.sh" <<'SH'

set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ -f android/gradlew ]; then
  cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -q
else
  echo "Missing android/gradlew — ensure project provides gradle wrapper" >&2
  exit 32
fi
SH
      chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" "$WORKSPACE/build.sh"
    else
      cat > "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" <<'SH'

set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"

SH
      chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/start.sh"

steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively: for Flutter run 'flutter pub get'; for JS projects use 'yarn --frozen-lockfile' if yarn.lock present or 'npm ci' when package-lock.json exists, otherwise 'npm i'. Validate Node version for React Native projects and fail with a clear message if Node is too old. Save install logs to workspace for evidence. Require project Gradle wrapper for Android builds (fail early if missing).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs"
if [ -f "pubspec.yaml" ]; then
  /opt/flutter/bin/flutter --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'flutter missing' >&2; exit 40; }
  /opt/flutter/bin/flutter pub get > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/flutter_pub_get.txt" 2>&1
elif [ -f "package.json" ]; then

steps.description: Run lightweight unit tests to verify test tooling. For Flutter run 'flutter test'. For JS run jest if configured in package.json. Create a minimal dummy jest test under __tests__ only when jest is configured and node_modules contains jest (or will be installed) and no tests exist. Capture outputs to workspace logs and return non-zero only on real test failures.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs"
if [ -f "pubspec.yaml" ]; then
  /opt/flutter/bin/flutter test > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/flutter_test.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'flutter tests failed' >&2; exit 50; }
elif [ -f "package.json" ]; then
  # detect jest robustly
  if node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({}, p.devDependencies||{}, p.dependencies||{}); if(deps.jest|| (p.scripts&&p.scripts.test&&p.scripts.test.includes('jest'))) process.exit(0); else process.exit(1)" 2>/dev/null; then
    # ensure jest installed in node_modules or will be installed - rely on previous dependency step
    if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ ! -f "node_modules/.bin/jest" ]; then
      # if node_modules absent, still attempt npx which will use local or remote install
      :
    fi
    # create __tests__/sanity.test.js only if no tests exist under conventional locations
    if ! find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name "*.test.js" -o -name "*.spec.js" -o -name "*.test.jsx" -o -path "*/__tests__/*" \) | grep -q .; then
      mkdir -p __tests__ && cat > __tests__/sanity.test.js <<'EOF'
test('sanity', () => { expect(1+1).toBe(2); });
EOF
    fi
    npx jest --silent --runInBand > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/jest_run.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'jest failed' >&2; exit 51; }
  else
    echo 'jest not configured; skipping JS tests' > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/jest_skip.txt"
  fi
else
  echo 'No supported project files for testing; skipping' > "$WORKSPACE/.tool_logs/test_skip.txt"
fi

steps.name: validation - build APK/artifacts, attempt install/start on connected device (non-fatal if no device), collect logs
steps.description: Validate environment by building an Android debug APK (flutter or gradle wrapper), locate artifact, detect connected adb devices (if any), attempt to install and start the app on first device, verify process, collect logcat and build/test logs. Do not fail the entire validation if adb missing or no devices; instead write explicit logs (adb_missing.txt or no_devices.txt) and exit 0 unless a build/test failed. Detect aapt/aapt2/apkanalyzer and fall back to unzip+grep of AndroidManifest.xml to extract package name when necessary.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/mobile-notes-manager-46315-46332/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs"
# compute sdk root defensively
ANDR_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-/opt/android-sdk}"
ADB_PATH="$ANDR_ROOT/platform-tools/adb"
# log java
java -version 2>&1 | head -n1 > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/java_version.txt" || true
# Build APK if possible
APK_PATH=""
if [ -f "pubspec.yaml" ]; then
  /opt/flutter/bin/flutter build apk --debug --no-shrink > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/flutter_build.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'flutter build failed' >&2; exit 60; }
  APK_PATH=$(find build -type f -name "*-debug.apk" | head -n1 || true)
elif [ -f "package.json" ]; then
  if [ -d android ] && [ -f android/gradlew ]; then
    (cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -q) > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/gradle_build.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'gradle build failed' >&2; exit 61; }
    APK_PATH=$(find android -path "*/outputs/apk/*/debug/*.apk" | head -n1 || true)
  else
    echo 'No android/gradlew to build APK; skipping APK build' > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/no_apk.txt"
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$APK_PATH" ] && [ -f "$APK_PATH" ]; then
  echo "$APK_PATH" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/built_apk_path.txt"
else
  echo 'No APK artifact found; will skip device install/start' > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/no_apk_found.txt"
fi
# check adb availability
if [ ! -x "$ADB_PATH" ] && ! command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'adb not available; skipping install/start' > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/adb_missing.txt"
  exit 0
fi
ADB_CMD=""
if [ -x "$ADB_PATH" ]; then ADB_CMD="$ADB_PATH"; else ADB_CMD=$(command -v adb); fi
$ADB_CMD version > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/adb_version.txt" 2>&1 || true
DEVLIST=$($ADB_CMD devices | sed '1d' | awk '{print $1}' | grep -v '^$' || true)
if [ -z "$DEVLIST" ]; then
  echo 'No adb devices connected; skipping install/start' > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/no_devices.txt"
  exit 0
fi
DEVICE=$(echo "$DEVLIST" | head -n1)
if [ -n "$APK_PATH" ] && [ -f "$APK_PATH" ]; then
  $ADB_CMD -s "$DEVICE" install -r "$APK_PATH" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/adb_install.txt" 2>&1 || { echo 'adb install failed' >&2; exit 62; }
  # find aapt/apkanalyzer
  AAPT=""
  if [ -x "$ANDR_ROOT/build-tools/33.0.2/aapt" ]; then AAPT="$ANDR_ROOT/build-tools/33.0.2/aapt"; fi
  if [ -z "$AAPT" ]; then
    # search for any aapt or aapt2
    AAPT=$(find "$ANDR_ROOT/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name aapt -o -name aapt2 \) | head -n1 || true)
  fi
  APKANALYZER=$(command -v apkanalyzer 2>/dev/null || true)
  PKG=""
  ACT=""
  if [ -n "$AAPT" ] && [ -x "$AAPT" ]; then
    PKG=$($AAPT dump badging "$APK_PATH" | awk -F"'" '/package: name=/{print $2; exit}') || true
    ACT=$($AAPT dump badging "$APK_PATH" | awk -F"'" '/launchable-activity: name=/{print $2; exit}') || true
  elif [ -n "$APKANALYZER" ]; then
    PKG=$(apkanalyzer manifest print --apk "$APK_PATH" | awk -F'package="' '/package=/{print $2; exit}' | cut -d'"' -f1) || true
  else
    # unzip fallback: extract manifest and grep package
    if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      unzip -p "$APK_PATH" AndroidManifest.xml 2>/dev/null | strings | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "package=\"[^\"]*\"" | head -n1 | sed 's/package="//;s/"//' > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/manifest_pkg.txt" || true
      PKG=$(cat "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/manifest_pkg.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)
    fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$PKG" ]; then
    if [ -n "$ACT" ]; then
      $ADB_CMD -s "$DEVICE" shell am start -n "$PKG/$ACT" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/adb_start.txt" 2>&1 || true
    fi
    sleep 2
    if $ADB_CMD -s "$DEVICE" shell ps -A | tr -d '\r' | grep -F "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "app $PKG running on $DEVICE" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/app_running.txt"
    else
      echo "app $PKG not detected via ps" > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/app_not_running.txt"
    fi
    $ADB_CMD -s "$DEVICE" logcat -d > "$WORKSPACE/adb_log_${DEVICE}.txt" || true
    $ADB_CMD -s "$DEVICE" shell am force-stop "$PKG" || true
    $ADB_CMD -s "$DEVICE" uninstall "$PKG" || true
  else
    echo 'Could not determine package name; installed APK but skipping start/uninstall steps' > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/could_not_determine_pkg.txt"
  fi
else
  echo 'No APK to install' > "$WORKSPACE/.validation_logs/no_apk_to_install.txt"
fi
exit 0

Refined env-001, scaffold-001, dependencies-001, test-001 and validation-001 to address analyst feedback: (1) env-001: compute/export JAVA_HOME immediately, install cmdline-tools defensively, chmod binaries, accept sdkmanager licenses non-interactively, install minimal build-tools; write /etc/profile.d/android.sh and source it for current session; validate sdkmanager/adb using full paths if needed. (2) scaffold-001: inject absolute WORKSPACE into generated start.sh/build.sh, avoid unconditional npm -g installs (use npx fallback), add chmod +x for /opt/flutter/bin/* and avoid running heavy flutter doctor interactions (use flutter --version and optional non-interactive precache). (3) dependencies-001: keep gradle wrapper requirement and make error messages actionable. (4) test-001: improve jest detection using node -p to parse package.json and only add a dummy test when appropriate. (5) validation-001: install minimal build-tools to enable aapt/apkanalyzer, avoid fragile pidof use (use adb shell ps|grep), ensure build artifacts/logs saved to workspace even if no devices attached. These changes were made to fix immediate executable/path/licensing issues, idempotency and non-interactive execution, and to provide robust APK metadata extraction during validation.
